build_awgn_loglikelihood: build a function that computes unnormalized log likelihood assuming additive iid Gaussian noise on the response variable
build_categorical_loglikelihood: build a function that computes unnormalized log likelihood assuming a categorical distribution for the response variable
compute_scale_mixture_normal: compute the sum of log probabilities for data points under a scale mixture of two 1D Gaussians
compute_sample_based_kl: compute the KL distance between a model and prior using sampled latent variables and a scale mixture prior
compute_analytical_kl: compute the analytical KL distance between a linear hypernetwork model and a Gaussian prior over latent parameters
